title: MMS1 magnetic field and plasma moments on 2025-06-01
publisher: NASA Magnetospheric Multiscale / Space Physics Data Facility
license_or_access_terms: CC0 per NASA SPDF data-use policy
deterministic_selection_rule: Whole daily magnetic survey CDF plus the complete matching 10:00-12:00 ion and electron moment files. No time-point filtering.

measurement_dates.description: 2025-06-01 daily FGM; ion/electron FPI moment files cover 10:00–12:00 UTC (first sample 10:00:04.084203, last 11:59:59.640192).
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: NASA Level-2 calibrated field data and distribution moments, not raw particle-event counts. FGM and FPI have different sampling and integration intervals; no resampling is supplied.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Single-spacecraft, short-interval observations cannot alone establish universal plasma equations or resolve full spatial structure. Instrument quality/error flags and coordinate frames are material. Use the SPDF data-use acknowledgments.
